status.ppml: pre-0.4.5 baseline; rerun required after execution/separation fixes

ppml_caveat: The supplied diagnosis establishes that the direct PPML API did not propagate ExecutionConfig threads/memory policy into its projector. PPML timings are preserved as observed historical results but must not be relabeled as a strict configured-thread benchmark.
immutability: The original pre-publication submission archives retain the untouched source records. Public-repository source and release bundles contain the declared redacted copies; both original and public hashes below remain immutable. Add follow-up runs as new files.

public_release_redaction.reason: The public repository copy must not disclose local machine paths, the local account name, or the identity of the confidential empirical projects that supplied the data.
